title: The Hedgeway
description: Leave the farm lane for a narrow hedgeway, pass through its tunnels and gaps, climb over the hedge and return to the countryside.

signs.text:
The open farm lane
Find the entrance between the farm hedges

The narrow hedge corridor
Short precise hops follow the enclosed lane

Gaps through the hedge
Drop through the hedge’s separated tunnels

The raised hedge-top route
Climb onto the clear tops above the tunnel

The countryside exit
The lane opens into another field
